title: Improve Home WebView operator trust feedback
summary: Improve Home and Sample Validation UI responsiveness, semantic state feedback, row selection, empty states, and pending-publish proof failure presentation.
reason: The Home operator surface needs immediate click feedback, clear blocked/loading/no-data states, and reliable no-mutation smoke coverage so daily operators can trust what changed without guessing.
behavior_before: Several Home and Sample Validation controls updated evidence indirectly or silently, selectable rows did not consistently show selected state, pending-publish proof refresh failures could leave proof panels looking empty, and no-data/blocked states were difficult to scan.
behavior_after: Home and Sample Validation controls expose immediate busy/selection/status feedback, pending-publish proof refresh failures render as blocked/review evidence, and no-data/blocked states are visibly differentiated without adding frontend mutation authority.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m pytest tests/webview/test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary.py -q - failed on unrelated pre-existing Queue/API owner expectation drift outside this packet

apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed because unrelated dirty files are uncovered: src/mediapipeline/core/schedule/grid.py; tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_schedule.py; tests/python/desktop/test_service_app_schedule.py; tests/python/tooling/test_autonomy_soak_tick.py
git diff --check -- touched Home/Sample Validation files - passed with line-ending warnings only
node --check changed WebView JS files - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the Home/Sample Validation WebView JS, HTML, CSS, smoke-test changes, refreshed summaries, and this change packet.
notes:
Do not add frontend media mutation, settings persistence, queue mutation, pending-publish drain, rename, launch, publish, or filesystem authority. Browser validation should remain fixture/no-mutation oriented. This packet also restores Sample Validation row state data attributes and removes a browser smoke race while preserving read-only behavior.
Implemented Home operator-trust feedback: refresh busy mirroring, row/list selection, semantic panel states, no-data/blocked states, run-state handoff, runtime open feedback, and non-mutating pending-publish failure presentation.
Added browser smoke assertions for Home refresh busy state, list/table selection, semantic data-state, Sample Validation decision strip, Preview Record feedback, Clear Manual Checks feedback, and non-mutation route filtering.
Sample Validation may attempt /api/ui-preferences from existing UI preference sync; the smoke interceptor blocks it and permits only /api/sample-validation/preview to reach the backend while asserting no append/start/settings-save/rename/drain mutation routes are attempted.
Added generated summary coverage for crossPageContextView.sample.js after refresh_summaries.
